title: Sorted Pair Target
statement: Given an array of integers sorted in ascending order and a target, return the indices [i, j] (i < j) of two numbers that add up to the target. If no pair exists, return [-1, -1]. Use O(1) extra space.

answerKey.pattern: Two pointers at opposite ends, using the sorted order
keyPoints: If nums[left] + nums[right] == target return [left, right]
If the sum is smaller, move left forward (increase the sum)
If the sum is larger, move right backward (decrease the sum)
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Hash map complement lookup: O(n) time but O(n) space, ignores the sorted order and the O(1) space requirement

hints: A hash map works but uses O(n) space. What does the sorted order tell you?
Start with the smallest and the largest number and look at their sum.
Too small: move the left pointer right. Too big: move the right pointer left.
